C11.why: Discriminates the whole class this row is about: whether an unauthenticated GET can retrieve the serialised configuration store. 讀 auth-flow.md: this path holds no `htm`, so the authorisation gate never runs on it. rlxfw's equivalent is GET /api/config, which 讀 notes/httpd.md § 2 requires a session, so an unauthenticated read there is 401 and an unknown path is 404.
